{npc:Tom}, Rookgaard's tanner, uses bear paws and can make you a pair of your own. Bring him 50 {item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws} and 50 {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws} and you get the first addon (Paws) of the {wiki:Druid Outfits}, the same one you earn from {npc:Ustan} on the mainland.
The same addon you get from Ustan on the mainland.
**Premium** account (the Druid Outfit is available to all Premium accounts; this quest only gives the addon).
You can collect all the paws before talking to Tom: that way you save a trip.
{item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws} drop from {creature:Bear|Bears} and {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws} from {creature:Wolf|Wolves}.
Hunt {creature:Bear|Bears} and {creature:Wolf|Wolves} in Rookgaard until you have **50 {item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws}** and **50 {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws}**.
Go to {npc:Tom}'s shop and say {key:hi} and {key:addon}. He asks you for 50 Bear Paws and 50 Wolf Paws.
With the paws in your inventory, say {key:paws} and confirm with {key:yes}. You receive the bear paw addon.
